h1: Educational Benefits of Outdoor Play in Schools

props.title: Educational Benefits of Outdoor Play in Schools
props.summaryText: Outdoor play is not time away from learning. How it supports attention, social skills, language, maths and science, and how teachers can use the playground as a learning space.
props.author: meera-iyer
props.imageAlt: Teacher with a group of schoolchildren in a classroom

takeaways.text: Outdoor play supports physical development that underpins writing, sitting and attention.
Group play builds communication, cooperation and self-regulation.
The playground can carry maths, science and language learning.
NEP 2020 emphasises play and activity-based learning, especially in the foundational years.

faq.q: What are the educational benefits of outdoor play?
faq.a: Outdoor play builds the physical skills that support writing and sitting still, improves attention after breaks, develops social and emotional skills, and provides hands-on opportunities to learn maths, science and language.

faq.q: How can teachers use the playground for learning?
faq.a: By using play equipment and outdoor spaces for counting, measuring, shapes, forces and motion, observing nature, storytelling and role play, and group problem-solving games.
Yes. The National Education Policy 2020 emphasises play-based and activity-based learning, especially in the foundational stage for children aged 3 to 8.
